instruction: Enable the minimal view mode in VLC.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC, navigated Tools > Preferences > Advanced (All) > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt, set 'Maximum Volume displayed' to 200, and saved. Task completed successfully.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate Advanced Preferences tree, find Qt interface settings, modify numeric values, and save preferences.
metadata.task_rationale: Same navigation pattern (Advanced Preferences > Qt interface) but targets a different setting (minimal view checkbox instead of volume). Tests the model's ability to find and enable a boolean setting in the same preferences section. Default is 0 (disabled).
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC Advanced Preferences > Qt interface and enabling 'Start in minimal view mode' (or equivalent qt-minimal-view setting). Evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks qt-minimal-view equals 1 (enabled). Default is 0 (disabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'vlc_config' correctly reads the vlcrc config file from the VM, which is the right source for VLC preference settings.

Metric 'check_qt_minimal_view' correctly accesses 'expected_qt_minimal_view' directly from the rule parameter (consistent with type='rule' framework behavior where get_rule returns rules dict directly).
Metric correctly searches for 'qt-minimal-view=' in the config file and compares the value against expected '1' (enabled), with default '0' (disabled).
Expected value of 1 is semantically correct for enabling minimal view mode in VLC.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC (forcing config write on exit) then relaunches it, ensuring the vlcrc file reflects the latest settings before the getter reads it.
Single instruction requirement (enable minimal view) is fully covered by the single evaluator check.
